debugData.name: Texture set surface
debugData.description: One texture set on a surface, any packing (p303 D7): the baseline of the terrain techniques, no anti-tiling or splat. Give a mesh its set with matOverrides.inputs.surface ({ textureSet, packing? }). Static defines: tiling (WORLD_XZ: the world's (x, -z) over physicalSize, for terrain; UV: the mesh's UV in metres, for walls and structures), minimalNormal (BUMP or FLAT).
